title: Weather
description: Bronze-layer dimension. One row per sample   typically one per minute during the session. ~150–300 rows per race day.
x-notes: rainfall_flag is boolean (true = precipitation detected). wind_direction is int16 (0–360). wind_speed_ms is in metres per second.

x-phantom-columns.name: rainfall_mm
x-phantom-columns.reason: Rain is a boolean flag (`rainfall_flag`) only; there's no cumulative millimetre channel.

x-phantom-columns.name: wind_direction_deg
x-phantom-columns.reason: The real column is `wind_direction` (degrees, plain integer).

x-phantom-columns.name: wind_speed_kmh
x-phantom-columns.reason: The real column is `wind_speed_ms` (metres per second, not km/h).

x-phantom-columns.name: session
x-phantom-columns.reason: Race weather has no session column at all; only qualifying weather gets `session_type="Q"`.

track_temp_c.description: Track surface temperature in Celsius. Typically 10–20°C higher than ambient on sunny days.

rainfall_flag.description: True if precipitation is detected during this sample period.

wind_direction.description: Wind direction in degrees (0–360°). Null if calm.

wind_speed_ms.description: Wind speed in metres per second.

session_time_s.description: Session elapsed time in seconds when this sample was recorded.

session_type.description: Only present on qualifying weather files, where it's always `"Q"`. Absent entirely from race weather; there is no `session` column on race files.
